gloss: to recommend; to endorse; to put forward

definitions.gloss: to recommend; to endorse; to put forward
definitions.explanation: To suggest a particular person, book, product, or option to someone as being good or suitable. Written 薦める when vouching for a specific thing or candidate.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{薦|すす}めます。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薦|すす}められて⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the movie because a friend recommended it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：30461_tenchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}メニュー→看板メニュー：17381_kanbanmenyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{薦|すす}めて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The manager confidently recommended the restaurant's signature dish.

notes:
Written with 薦 when recommending a specific item, work, or candidate as worthy of being chosen. The recommender vouches for the thing's quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{薦|すす}める: to recommend a book
- ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{薦|すす}める: to put forward as a candidate
- ⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{薦|すす}める: to recommend with confidence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勧|すす}める→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧: to urge; to encourage — recommends doing an action, e.g. ⟦{入会|にゅうかい}→入会：11671_nyuukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}める→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧; the two spellings overlap and are often used interchangeably
- ⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to advance; to move forward — an unrelated verb with the same reading

forms.negative: {薦|すす}めていませんでした
